title: [Bug][Subscription Billing] "Cancellation Possible Until" is rounded to the end of the month when the Notice Period is expressed in days
summary: Fixed an issue where subscription line cancellation dates were incorrectly rounded to month-end when notice periods were expressed in days or weeks, potentially allowing cancellations outside agreed notice windows. Added logic to only apply month-end alignment for month-based formulas.
key_points: Subscription cancellation dates no longer snap to month-end for day or week-based notice periods
Added DateFormulaManagement.IsMonthBasedDateFormula() to distinguish month-based from day/week-based formulas
Applied fix to three calculation methods: CalculateCancellationPossibleUntil, CalculateTermUntilFromCancellationPossibleUntil, and CalculateTermUntilUsingExtensionTerm
Composite formulas like <1Y+6M> are correctly identified as month-based, while formulas with day or week components are not
Added 10 test methods covering day, week, month, quarter, and composite formulas
